_how: Copy this file, fill it in for one person, then run: node scripts/brand-kit.mjs their-brand.json (a kit they run) or node scripts/client.mjs add their-brand.json (you edit their footage on this Mac). Fields starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
name: Jane Doe

colors._note: text = caption color, accent = the highlight (hook keyword, gold word, card accents), stroke = outline, bg = card background

fonts._note: A Google Fonts family name (Bebas Neue, Montserrat ExtraBold, Oswald) or a path to a .ttf. display = hook titles, climax words, pop captions, cover titles; body = reveal captions, cards, carousels. Leave out to keep Anton and Inter.

look._note: hook: headline | gold | box. captions: reveal (word by word) | pop (bold outlined). annotate: hand-drawn marker on the key word. slams: climax words that stamp in. behind: the hook runs behind their head.

looks._note: Card looks that do not fit this brand, turned off for their reels: receipts, phone, fieldnotes, briefing, press, shopfloor, blueprint, casefile, redline, glass. Leave empty to allow all.

world: Who they are and where they live and work, for the b-roll: their business, their city, their setting, the things that show up in their life. One or two sentences, concrete.
carouselStyle: The look of their carousel pictures: light, colors, texture. Never another creator's style.
voice: How they talk in captions: who they talk to, words they use, words they never use, how long, emojis or not.
_cta: Client folders only: the on-screen call to action and caption CTA ("Comment PRICE"). Empty = none.
